footnotes: The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Sep 30, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in fiscal 2025 (ended Sep 30, 2025). The operating loss widened to $46.2M from $10.6M.
The net loss widened to $40.1M, or −$1.06 per share, from $10.2M. Operating cash flow was −$19.6M and free cash flow −$28.1M, versus −$10.2M.
